verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud's docs list official SDKs for JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and Rust, and the open-source JS library runs in browsers and Deno, so a few major languages are covered. The story's named languages PHP, Ruby and Go are not listed, and nothing shows how current the SDKs are kept. Missing for 10: official PHP, Ruby and Go SDKs, evidence the SDKs are kept current or in version parity, framework-specific integrations, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, official SDKs cover my language and framework, kept current across JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, and more

citations.quote: Orama Cloud officially supports the following SDKs: - JavaScript/TypeScript - Python - Rust
With Deno, you can just use the same CDN URL or use npm specifiers
